reviewer: Coordinating author; distinct calculation methods and a second editorial pass, not a separate agent or human
scope: Five worked examples, ten complete exercise solutions, answered teach-back and delayed retention, three scoped primary readings, portable seven-case exact-rational lab.
proof_audit: Carry: replicated every dated net receipt with a matching borrowing/deposit strip, positive terminal discount, old strike unchanged. Full equality explicitly requires reversible carry rights; commodity cash-and-carry only upper-bounds when reverse rights absent.
FX: domestic-per-foreign units checked against foreign discount deposit and domestic repayment; distinct executable lending/borrowing sides derive both thresholds.

Futures: one-step gross factor is known at current node, remaining contract resets to zero, terminal fixing equals underlying; conditional tower gives Q mean and covariance identity. Added explicit qualification that unspecified/incomplete markets need not identify unique Q.
Tree: node spots, cash account and positive state prices agree; terminal known atdate1 gives zero final variation, and funded cash differs from nominal cumulative variation.

Swap: deposit-linked floating note resets to par under matched funding/default assumptions. Discount-ratio telescoping applies only to that model; separately defined payment-weighted projection is not a physical forecast. Known fixing and contractual-coupon derivative correctly distinguished.

Collateral: certain one-period claim fully financed by reusable equal-value cash collateral with specified return; limitations prevent generalizing to segregated margin or arbitrary derivative discounting.
Basis/minimum variance: explicitly defined signed basis and benchmark units, positive variance for unique quadratic minimum; degenerate variance and integer/execution limits stated.
